entry.headline: Comfortable Weimar, inefficient habits, Ilm forgotten

entry.headline: Weimar at crossroads: care and carelessness coexist

changes.title: River education begins
changes.story: School groups now visit the Ilm. Small signs mark its banks. Awareness grows quietly.

changes.title: Car culture still dominant
changes.story: SUVs idle outside offices. Solo commuting persists. Public transit underused. Habit trumps efficiency.

entry.thought: 2048: Weimar fractures—solar panels and tree-cutting, pickups and litter, attic insulation and idle engines. Care and carelessness fight. River still blank. Pre

surprise.title: Ilm flooding after spring thaw
surprise.story: Heavy snow melt and blocked culverts cause the Ilm to breach its banks near Goetheplatz. Raw sewage surfaces. A wake-up call.

entry.headline: Weimar splits: half-measures, mixed signals, old habits hold

changes.title: Ilm breach near Goetheplatz
changes.story: Spring melt floods low areas. Raw sewage spills. Community forms task force to clear culverts and restore riverbank.

changes.title: Solar panels spreading
changes.story: Homeowners near green spaces invest in rooftop solar after flood alarm. Visible on older villas and terraces.

changes.title: Ilm restoration begins
changes.story: Flood triggers citizens' group to remove litter, plant willows, map culverts. First real Ilm attention in years.

entry.thought: 2077: Weimar has learned slowly. Half the town cycles and saves energy; half still drives and wastes. The Ilm flooded once, was cleaned partly. Care and careles
entry.headline: Weimar at 2077: mixed habits, partial green, river still wounded
entry.outlook: Weimar has split in half: one side solar-lit and cycling, the other still driving and wasting; the Ilm breathes again but remembers the flood; care and carelessness live as neighbors.

changes.title: Bikes now half the traffic
changes.story: Cycle lanes marked, bike repair stands. Young and old ride. Cars share space, grudgingly.

changes.title: Rooftops wear panels
changes.story: Solar panels on half of all roofs now. Heating bills dropped. Night lights dimmer. A slow win.

changes.title: River half-healed, still scarred
changes.story: Water clearer. Reeds grow. Fish returned. But litter lingers. Flooding scar visible. Progress, not cure.
